Ordoa 取自 Ordo（秩序）加上 Avalonia 的 A。安序希望用克制: Ordoa comes from Ordo (order) plus the A of Avalonia. Ordoa aims for a restrained, clear interface that keeps everyday file operations close at hand and advanced capabilities within reach when needed.
Ordoa 是一个开源项目。图标、界面与代码均可自由修改。远程连接密码优先保存在: Ordoa is an open-source project. Icons, UI, and code are freely modifiable. Remote passwords are stored in the system keyring (libsecret / Keychain) when available, otherwise in a config file readable only by the current user.
